subject.title: BL-ecommerce-checkout: Cart & Checkout — specs, aislamiento y tests

question: Should AlexDiaz-Hamelyn proceed with the Cart & Checkout BL block now, and should the shipping-group boundary be kept in checkout or deferred to the related shipping/localization/order-sell blocks during F1?
rationale: The repository BL workflow makes F2 owner validation blocking, and the current source has a known domain-boundary ambiguity that automation should not settle before writing validated specs.

options.title: Proceed with F1/F2 first
options.body: Extract the current rules, flag the shipping-group boundary, and validate all flags and rule text with the named owner before any isolation or tests.

options.title: Narrow the block
options.body: If F1 finds more than the expected rule count, split or defer only after the owner chooses the boundary rather than letting the worker repartition it.

options.title: Pause the BL block
options.body: Leave the issue open but do not start extraction until checkout ownership or adjacent coupon/localization boundaries are rescheduled.

recommendation.title: Proceed with F1/F2 first
recommendation.body: Extract the current rules, flag the shipping-group boundary, and validate all flags and rule text with the named owner before any isolation or tests.
